_why: Two dev servers, detected from package.json: `vite` (dev) and `vite preview`.
CLAUDE.md distinguishes them and the distinction matters: dev runs with NO
service worker, preview serves the real build and exercises the actual
worker. The ERR_FAILED bug this repo already paid for was invisible to dev
and to curl, and only reproduced in a browser with the worker installed —
so `preview` is the config to reach for after touching sw.js, vercel.json
or the page entries.
runtimeExecutable is an ABSOLUTE PATH TO NODE 22, not `npm`, on purpose.
package.json pins engines >=22.12 and the system node here is 20.11.1.
A bare `npm run dev` therefore dies with `SyntaxError: The requested module
'node:util' does not provide an export named 'styleText'` from inside
rolldown — which reads like a dependency bug and is really Node-too-old.
Calling vite's own bin with a known-good node skips both the npm wrapper
and the PATH lookup that reintroduces node 20.
FRAGILE, AND KNOWINGLY SO: that node path is a session-scoped scratchpad
download, not an installation. There is no durable Node 22 on this machine
(no nvm, no node@22 in homebrew, /usr/local/bin/node is 20.11.1). When it
disappears, install Node 22 properly and replace both runtimeExecutable
values with that path — or with plain "npm" once `node -v` reports 22.
preview sits on 4174, not vite preview's default 4173: a long-running
vite preview from the MAIN checkout already holds 4173 on this machine.
Several worktrees of this repo are live at once and this is the same port
contention CLAUDE.md records for VERIFY_PORT — the fix there was to move,
not to kill whoever legitimately holds it.
